title: Hong Kong Opens 24/7 Secondary Trading for Two Tokenized Public Funds
why_it_matters: The approval moves regulated tokenized funds beyond issuance into continuous secondary-market trading, testing pricing, liquidity and investor safeguards on licensed infrastructure.
caption:
RWA WIRE // INSTITUTIONS

Hong Kong Opens 24/7 Secondary Trading for Two Tokenized Public Funds

Hong Kong's securities regulator approved around-the-clock secondary trading of two ChinaAMC tokenized money market funds on an SFC-licensed virtual asset platform.
